instrument: Compass Datacenters letter to City of El Mirage, Dec 18, 2023 (APS microgrid)
summary: Compass states it spent twelve months with APS on a microgrid that would power the site and respond to capacity or frequency events on the APS grid; contract language and design were unresolved and expected to affect final campus design. The landscape plan shows an on-site APS substation and access road.

source.citation: Compass letter (Brett Collard, VP Corporate Development) in El Mirage P&Z packet, Jan 9, 2024

notes: Asserted by the applicant. Settled by an APS filing or ACC docket for a Compass microgrid or grid-services agreement.
confidence_note: No APS or ACC document read.
